_comment: Your own notes, shown in the HTML and Word reports (--finding-notes). Keys under 'rules' are check ids (e.g. 'OPEN_EXTERNAL_JS_CHECK') or families ending in '*' (e.g. 'TRAFFIC_*', 'RUNTIME_MARKER_*'); an exact id wins over a family. Every field is optional; lists are shown as bullet points. Keys under 'fuses' are fuse names; their text is the impact of the PACKAGED_FUSES and FUSES findings for that fuse.

TRAFFIC_*.about: Your explanation of this family of findings.
TRAFFIC_*.confirm: How your team confirms or detects this.

OPEN_EXTERNAL_JS_CHECK.reachability: Your note on how reachable this is in practice.
OPEN_EXTERNAL_JS_CHECK.confirm: How to confirm or detect it.

fuses.RunAsNode: Your impact text for this fuse.
